sql:
SELECT l.ordered_on AS day, l.store_no, l.item_no, 'total' AS series, l.sales_dollars AS value
FROM sales.invoice_line l
JOIN sales.store s ON s.store_no = l.store_no
WHERE l.item_no IN (
    SELECT i.item_no FROM sales.item i
    JOIN sales.item h ON h.item_no = i.family_item_no
    WHERE h.item_desc ILIKE '%FIREBALL%'
)
AND s.county_name = 'LINN'
AND l.ordered_on >= '2016-01-01'
assumptions: Fireball brand includes every item whose current family name contains FIREBALL: Cinnamon Whiskey, Blazin Apple, Torch'd Vanilla, minis, gift packs, etc, in all sizes.
Products matched on their family item number since item numbers were renumbered over time.
Place is Linn County, Iowa, based on the store's county.
Next quarter is the quarter after the one in progress: data runs through August 2026 (Q3 2026 in progress), so next quarter is Q4 2026 (October-December 2026), forecast in full.
Revenue measured as sales_dollars on the order line.
title: Fireball Revenue Forecast - Linn County, Next Quarter
product: Fireball (all Fireball-branded products: Cinnamon Whiskey, Blazin Apple, Torch'd Vanilla, all sizes and packs)

sql:
SELECT
  l.ordered_on AS day,
  l.store_no AS store_no,
  l.item_no AS item_no,
  'total' AS series,
  l.sales_bottles AS value
FROM sales.invoice_line l
WHERE l.ordered_on >= DATE '2016-01-01'
  AND l.item_no IN (
    SELECT i.item_no
    FROM sales.item i
    WHERE i.category_current IN (
      SELECT category_code FROM sales.category WHERE category_name ILIKE '%CREAM%LIQUEUR%'
    )
  )
assumptions: 'Cream liqueur' is read as the Cream Liqueurs category (today's taxonomy), all products in that category, all sizes.
'For the holidays' is read as through December 31, 2026.
Data runs through August 31, 2026, so the forecast horizon is the 4 months September through December 2026.
No breakout requested: one total series across all Iowa stores.
Measure is bottles ordered (sales_bottles), which counts mini sleeves/packs by individual bottle where known.
title: Cream Liqueur bottle demand through the holidays (Dec 2026)
product: Cream liqueur (category: Cream Liqueurs)

product: Captain Morgan (all sizes and flavors, brand family)
